headlines.title: Iran war tensions loom over Trump-Netanyahu meeting
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is set to meet with President Donald Trump and attend the late Sen. Lindsey Graham’s funeral.

headlines.title: Washington says goodbye to Sen. Lindsey Graham
headlines.description: A special ceremony at the Capitol and a funeral service at the National Cathedral on Tuesday will be private, but both events will be livestreamed for the public.

headlines.title: Justice Department Releases Biden Audio Files After Legal Battle
headlines.description: Private audio recorded by Joe Biden years ago, that he expected to remain private, has been released by the Department of Justice after a legal battle. The 2016 and 2017 conversations with a ghostwriter cover the death of his son Beau and his time as vice president. In the recording, he's heard warning the author that material from his files might be top secret. NBC's Kelly O'Donnell reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Talks Economic Turnaround in Battleground Michigan
headlines.description: Ahead of the crucial midterm elections in the fall, President Donald Trump stressed an economic turnaround while speaking in battleground Michigan on Monday, arguing his tariffs have helped an auto industry that relies on a global supply chain. He also insisted higher gas prices driven by the Iran war will come down. It comes as a recent poll shows nearly two-thirds of Americans disapprove of his handling of the economy. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to let executive order on mail-in voting proceed
headlines.description: Trump has asked the Supreme Court to allow him to implement his executive order that seeks to exert control over mail ballots submitted in state-run elections. NBC News' Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Witness in Reflecting Pool case conceded damage before canoeist touched water
headlines.description: A key grand jury witness in a case against a former Olympic canoeist accused of tampering with the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool testified that the area was already damaged and would have required repairs regardless, lawyers said in a court filing.

headlines.title: Can Susan Collins defy political gravity again? From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Trump, Congress and world leaders to honor the late Sen. Lindsey Graham in Washington
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy will be in attendance Tuesday. A funeral service in South Carolina will follow Wednesday.

headlines.title: Citing ‘common sense,’ James Comey’s team urges judge to toss seashells case
headlines.description: Attorneys for the former FBI director say the indictment “targets and chills core political speech and fails as a matter of law.”

headlines.title: Mitch McConnell releases health update, saying he’s not ready to return to work yet
headlines.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell’s office released a health update Monday, saying he’s still not ready to return to in-person work after his June 14 hospitalization.

headlines.title: Sen. John Hoffman says Angie Craig sought his endorsement while he was in ICU
headlines.description: Democratic Minnesota state Sen. John Hoffman said Rep. Angie Craig, D-Minn., sought his endorsement for her Senate campaign while he was in intensive care following the June 2025 attempt on his life.
